item.title: Group reports totals by currency
item.brief: Update reports.py to read current ledger CSV and legacy CSV without currency; default absent currency to USD. Validate currency as precisely three uppercase ASCII letters; invalid currency prints stderr error and exits 2. Output header account,currency,total_cents, totals by account and currency sorted by account then currency. Update README, run python3 -m unittest, and commit changes.
